name: William Roche
heroText: Senior CS student at NYU with a math minor, currently TA-ing the undergraduate software engineering course. I like solving problems, researching, and building things that are useful to people.
aboutText: I'm a senior at NYU studying Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics, after transferring from The College of New Jersey. Most of what I build is in finance and systems — tax engines, real-time market data, and ETL pipelines. Before that, I spent a summer in a quantum hardware lab fabricating graphene Josephson junctions.
